# D194 saved-separation tables

24 October 2026. [Interpretation](YOKED_SEPARATION_RESULTS.md).
Mechanically rendered from the pinned, independently saved-audited diagnostic.
All four exposed histories, both families/roles/futures and all 64 records remain.
Pair distances are measured first, then averaged within record across paired views.
Relative RMS below is multiplied by 100: percent of pooled field amplitude,
not percent of information lost. Other geometry fields remain in native units.
Min/median/max refer to record quantities after role/draw/future averaging.
Block/message intersections, omissions and distributions remain in the
[external summary](/mnt/bioIce1/PlasticHeredity/codex.lawsConfirmation/L22-yoked-separation-v1/outputs/SUMMARY.json); per-record arrays
are retained alongside it in the four history NPZ files.
Donor time_max takes a separate maximum for each metric and record; it is
not a single field pair at one common maximum-distance time.
